item.title: Bills to go up by over $5 a month for 140,000 natural gas users in Kansas
item.description: TOPEKA (KSNT) - Some natural gas users in Kansas will be seeing higher rates following a settlement agreement reached on Thursday. The Kansas Corporation Commission announced on Feb. 26 that it has unanimously approved a settlement agreement on Feb. 26. item.title: Body found in semi truck trailer at Topeka gas station
item.description: Topeka police recovered the body of a trucker Thursday at a local truck stop and gas station.

item.title: Pedestrian critically injured after west Topeka crash
item.description: First responders are at the scene of a vehicle vs. pedestrian crash Thursday afternoon at a busy west Topeka intersection.

item.title: Spring Hill residents raise concerns over rezoning plan for data center
item.description: People who live in Spring Hill are pushing back against a rezoning plan that they say opens the door to a possible data center and to a change in their way of life.

item.title: Traffic expected to change on I-70 in Geary County
item.description: TOPEKA (KSNT) – Drivers on I-70 in Geary County can expect traffic disruptions starting next week due to installations of a safety barrier. item.title: Kansas' first 3D printed house combats affordable housing crisis
item.description: TOPEKA (KSNT) - As affordable housing shortages continue across the country and in Kansas, a local developer is turning to 3D-printing technology to lower home prices and speed up construction.
